rules.title: No em or en dashes in copy
rules.statement: Prose must not contain an em dash or an en dash.
rules.rationale: Unprompted dash-heavy punctuation is a reliable signature of generated prose.
rules.message: Em/en dash in copy: replace with a comma, period, or reword.

rules.title: No pure black
rules.statement: Color values must not be pure black.
rules.rationale: Pure black against white is harsh on screens and reads as an unconsidered default.
rules.message: Pure black (#000). Use an off-black token (e.g. zinc-950).

rules.title: No fabricated metrics
rules.statement: Copy must not state performance figures, adoption counts, or uptime percentages that are not real.
rules.rationale: Invented social proof is the most damaging slop tell because it makes the artifact dishonest rather than merely generic.
rules.message: Looks like a fabricated metric. Use real numbers or remove.

rules.title: No raw hex outside token declarations
rules.statement: Color values must reference a token rather than stating a hex literal.
rules.rationale: A literal decouples the value from the system, so the system stops describing the artifact.
rules.message: Raw hex outside a token declaration. Reference a token via var(--...).

rules.title: Images carry alt text
rules.statement: Every img element must have an alt attribute.
rules.rationale: A missing attribute leaves a screen reader to announce the file name.
rules.message: Image without alt. Add alt text, or alt="" if decorative.

rules.title: Focus indication survives
rules.statement: A rule that removes the focus outline must be accompanied by a :focus-visible replacement.
rules.rationale: Removing the outline without replacing it makes keyboard navigation untrackable.
rules.message: Focus outline removed with no :focus-visible replacement.

rules.title: Clickable elements are semantic
rules.statement: A div or span carrying an onclick handler must declare a role.
rules.rationale: A generic element is not focusable and announces nothing, so the interaction exists only for a mouse.
rules.message: Clickable div/span without a role. Use a button/link, or add role plus keyboard support.

rules.title: No indigo or purple gradients
rules.statement: Gradient declarations must not interpolate between indigo, violet, or purple hues.
rules.rationale: It is the most recognizable signature of machine-generated interface work.
rules.evidence: Present in the majority of unprompted LLM-authored landing pages.
rules.message: Indigo/purple gradient: the #1 AI-slop tell. Pick a deliberate accent.

rules.title: Eyebrows stay rare
rules.statement: All-caps kicker labels must not exceed one per three sections.
rules.rationale: An eyebrow above every section stops signalling anything and becomes texture.
rules.message: Too many all-caps kickers. Cap eyebrows at 1 per 3 sections.

rules.title: Grid tracks resist overflow
rules.statement: A grid track sized 1fr should be written minmax(0,1fr).
rules.rationale: A bare 1fr track has an auto minimum, so long content forces the cell wider than its share.
rules.message: Grid uses 1fr; prefer minmax(0,1fr) so cells don't overflow.

rules.title: One label per call to action
rules.statement: Two calls to action on one page must not carry the same label.
rules.rationale: Repeating a label hides which action the page actually wants.
rules.message: A CTA label repeats; use one label per CTA intent.

rules.title: Text pairs clear WCAG AA
rules.statement: Conventional foreground and background token pairs must reach a contrast ratio of 4.5:1.
rules.rationale: Below this ratio, body text stops being legible for a substantial share of readers.
rules.evidence: parse_tokens is last-wins: when a token is declared twice (e.g. a base value overridden inside a prefers-color-scheme: dark block), only the last-declared value is checked. A light-mode-only contrast failure on a token later overridden for dark mode is not caught by this check.
rules.message: Token pair falls below WCAG AA 4.5:1.

rules.title: Artifacts are self-contained
rules.statement: An artifact must not reference an asset on an external host.
rules.rationale: A remote reference makes the artifact stop working offline and couples the design to someone else's uptime.
rules.message: External dependency. Artifacts must be self-contained; inline or vendor it.

rules.title: Token references resolve
rules.statement: Every var(--token) reference must name a custom property defined in tokens.css.
rules.rationale: An unresolved reference falls back to nothing, so the failure is silent and only visible in the rendered page.
rules.message: References a token that is not defined in tokens.css.

rules.title: Components document when not to use them
rules.statement: Each component in components.css should carry a "Not for:" line in design.md naming an alternative.
rules.rationale: Knowing when to reach for something else is what prevents a modal being used for a message.
rules.message: Component has no "Not for:" line in design.md section 4.

examples.content:
## 4. Component Stylings
- Button `.btn`: solid fill.
  Not for: destructive actions, use `.btn--danger`.

rules.title: Hero fits in one viewport
rules.statement: The hero section must fit within one viewport without scrolling.
rules.rationale: A hero that requires a scroll to see in full reads as an ordinary section rather than a first impression, and undercuts the one thing the page most wants seen immediately.

rules.title: Headline stays to two lines
rules.statement: The hero headline should wrap to no more than two lines at common viewport widths.
rules.rationale: A headline that runs to three or more lines is usually saying too much at once, and starts competing with the hero's supporting content for attention.

rules.title: Subtext stays under 20 words
rules.statement: Hero subtext should stay under 20 words.
rules.rationale: Subtext this long stops supporting the headline and starts restating the page below it, which is a sign the hero is trying to do the whole page's job.
